_comment: Dated volunteer shifts from Galaxy Digital 'Get Connected' portals, read by mapsee_ingest_galaxydigital.py. Every portal is the same template on its own host: /need/ lists the needs (12 a page), /need/detail/?need_id=N is one need with its Location table and its Shifts table (or one 'Happens On' date and clock). Read the adapter's header before adding a portal: a portal is a CITY or COUNTY department's (its own terms checked), the listing's standing roles are refused unread, and a meeting place that is not a street address needs a measured pin in location_overrides or it is refused.
_conduct: Checked 2026-10-25 with our own User-Agent. robots.txt is one 1,151-byte file on every portal read (Portland, Olympia, Mecklenburg, WWU) and on api2.galaxydigital.com: 27 SEO crawlers Disallow: /, Crawl-delay 10 for bingbot, and 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' for everyone else. https://www.galaxydigital.com/terms-and-conditions is the licence between Galaxy and its CUSTOMER ('as long as You meet any applicable payment obligations', 'Your Principal Organization'); it forbids the customer to 'Reproduce, modify, copy, deconstruct, sell, trade, or resell the Services' (the software) and says nothing of reading the public pages. Each portal's footer 'Terms and Conditions' link is its /privacy page (volunteers' data only). The operators' own sites: portland.gov's 'Terms and policies' are ADA, captioning and privacy (https://www.portland.gov/help/about/privacy: nothing on reuse); https://www.olympiawa.gov/info/privacy_and_security_notice.php says 'Information presented on our web site is considered public information and may be distributed or copied. Use of appropriate byline credits is requested.' and that 'lists of individuals or directory information (including address, phone or email) may not be used for commercial purposes' - no person is copied; https://www.mecknc.gov/Policies/Privacy-and-Legal-Notices restricts only the County Seal. No terms forbid automated reading or republishing. The adapter copies no person: the Site Supervisor block is never read and a description sentence giving an e-mail address, a phone number or a named contact is dropped.

_not_included.https://volunteer.wwu.edu: Western Washington University's Community Service Center portal (agencies post needs for WWU students). Its own terms could not be read on 2026-10-25: www.wwu.edu's TLS chain failed our client, so even its robots.txt was unreachable (RFC 9309: assume Disallow). Its listing is 30 pages, and 49 of the first 60 needs are standing roles ('Is Ongoing' 44, 'Runs Until' 4, a range 1); of the 11 one-offs read, 10 give a street address (9 occasions: Bellingham Parks work parties, four blood-drive shifts, the Y's Halloween, a run posted twice). Add it once wwu.edu's terms are read.
_not_included.https://volunteer.portland.gov/need/deta: Forest Park Restoration Stewardship Event: Location 'Holman ln' only. Photon answers a 1.5 km path (W 113897048, lon -122.7318 to -122.7193); the prose says park at NW Savier and NW Aspen and walk to 'the trailhead', which no source here places. Refused (5 shifts on 2026-10-25) until a pin is measured.

Pier Park Plant Pals: Location 'N Lombard St and N Bruce Ave'. Census answers no intersection, and Photon's North Bruce Avenue is a 240 m segment (lon -122.7612 to -122.7582) whose Lombard end could not be told from its other; the park's own point is 370 m from that segment. Refused (1 shift) until a pin is measured.

portals.name: Portland Parks & Recreation
portals._found: manual:2026-10-25 volunteer track (Galaxy Digital). Rose City Bluff Restoration meets every Sunday at 9:30; no catalog source carried any of these.
portals._measured: 2026-10-25, two live runs on a scratch store, 54 requests each: the listing is 5 pages, 52 needs - 38 'Multiple Shifts Available', 10 'Happens On', 4 'Flexible' (refused unread). Of the 48 need pages read: 64 dated shifts kept inside 90 days (34 pinned by location_overrides, 30 at 14 street addresses the Census matched 14 of 14); 12 needs refused for a background check, 1 skipped programme, 7 with no Location, 2 at a place with no pin (_not_included); 4 midnight placeholder shifts and 1 full one refused.
portals.signup_line: Sign up with Respond on its page at volunteer.portland.gov (a free account).
portals._skip_programs_comment: SUN Community Schools: 13 of Portland's 48 dated needs on 2026-10-25, every one an after-school club at a middle school (Beaumont, Lane, Brentwood) - chess, art, soccer, a yearbook - with a weekly slot through the school year. 12 require a background check and 'Activities w/ Youth'; the 13th (a Dungeons and Dragons club) asks for a club leader. A role inside a school's programme for its own students, not a shift the public can join.
